title: The Vanished Honey Pot Lid
intro: The prize-winning cider jug has gone missing from the farmers market's jam table, and it was last seen in the middle of the morning rush.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: Cider's my specialty, so I was tasting all morning.

suspects.name: Wren
suspects.line: I was painting faces by the fountain all morning.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I've been selling tomatoes since sunrise. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Who's been moving my crate of squash?

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only came for the cheese stall, honestly.

clues.text: The lemonade vendor swears the culprit is not the one who ordered lemonade; the cup count at her cart has been perfectly balanced all morning.
Clean red sneaker prints lead away from the scene, and the culprit's footprints are not red sneakers; these muddy tracks came from someone else entirely.
The iced tea urn is still full to the brim, so the culprit is not the one who drank iced tea today.
A sticky ring and a crumpled napkin suggest the culprit was sipping apple cider while hovering near the jam table.
